notes.title: Vaultbreakers
notes.content:
Every game has its pioneers—the players who refuse to accept boundaries and instead redefine what’s possible. In Starborne: Frontiers, those pioneers are known as the Vaultbreakers: Mathmadman and Seyphir. Together, they approached the Vault battles with determination, creativity, and relentless testing.

A Chance Encounter
Both players started their Frontiers journeys separately, but fate had other plans.“I first ran into Seyphir in our previous alliance, then moved to Galaxy Guards shortly after him,” recalls Mathmadman. What began as casual collaboration quickly became a shared obsession: solving the riddle of the Hermes/Hayyan Cheat Death compositions.
For Seyphir, the inspiration came directly from his new teammate:“Got inspired by the great Mathmadman. We both like Crocus and so we got in contact and talked and exchanged ideas.”
That spark would soon ignite one of the game’s most influential discoveries.

Building the Impossible
The duo set their sights on what many considered an unsolvable problem: creating a team that could keep Hermes’ Cheat Death active every single round. For Mathmadman, it became an engineering challenge:“At this point it became a question of generating six instances of crit per round with only four units.”
Dozens of tests, breakdowns, and “what if” scenarios followed. When Mathmadman finally saw success, he sent Seyphir a simple but unforgettable message:

    “It worked… IT WORKED!!!”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45163929/8dbc6f8b577c05f6effa5acdfadbbfe18170f18d.png

That run lasted ninety minutes and dealt 84 million damage—a personal best at the time, and the first true proof-of-concept for what would become known as the Vaultbreaker team.

Cracking Vaults, One by One
From that breakthrough, the pair turned their attention to the game’s toughest challenges. Antimatter and Thermal Vaults fell first, using the same compositions. But Chemical Vault proved elusive.
“We had no solution for Chemical,” Mathmadman admits. “Almost every double-attacker is Electric.”Xcellence looked promising but failed to deliver. The breakthrough came in the most unexpected place—Tormentor’s passive:

    “This unit always lands critical hits.”

“I've never seen such a beautiful sentence before,” says Mathmadman.

Together, the duo crafted a setup that not only conquered Chemical Vault but went on to record-breaking results. Seyphir’s final run hit the milestone that cemented their legacy:
The first billion-damage battle in Starborne: Frontiers history.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45163929/8b09ebcdb3b908b9c6eda7784a96f01655c4cc82.png

Lessons for the Community
Beyond the numbers and the records, both Vaultbreakers emphasize one core message: experimentation.“Try things, even if you think it will fail,” urges Mathmadman. “Just because no one has tried a build doesn’t mean it isn’t viable.”
Seyphir echoes that sentiment:“To all players out there trying to find new stuff: just do it and test things, re-read abilities of Units and also ask for help or ideas!”

A Legacy of Discovery
The name “Vaultbreakers” now stands for more than just a team—it’s a mindset.
 A refusal to accept limits. A reminder that with creativity, persistence, and a touch of flair, players can achieve the impossible.
Or, in the words of Mathmadman:
“If you’re going to set records, you gotta do it with flair.”

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.22
notes.content:
Features

Faction Ops - Quality of Life update

Multibattles are now available in Faction Ops.
Each faction will now open for 48 hours by default instead of 24 hours. 
(This new rotation will start with the next daily reset).
2 factions will be open each day.
Faction Ops battles always use a key, unless the battle is lost before the first success is achieved in the given stage.
Faction Ops for specific factions are always available when all encounters for that faction have been completed with 3 stars.
Faction Ops keys now fully refill at midnight, instead of regenerating 1 key every few hours.
Faction Ops access for specific factions can now be purchased for 48 hours for 1000 plat.
Earned equipment loot can now be previewed during multibattles.
A pop-up to preview the squad leaders has been added.
The Starmap header now displays different keys depending on the subpanel being viewed.
Login times have been drastically reduced by up to 85%. A previous login time of 30-40 seconds has now been reduced to 5-7 seconds.

Balance

The “Unextendable” tag has been added to Echoing Burst and Bombs.
Ignore Defense and Shield Penetration are now explained in the "More Info" stat breakdown popup in the unit view in the Hangar.
Units with the "Bypass Shield" mechanic as part of their skills have received balance adjustments. They no longer possess the "Bypass Shield" ability. Instead, many now feature Shield Penetration. Additionally, several units within Binderburg have gained Shield Penetration. The scaling of both basic and charged skills for these units has also been adjusted.

The Active Skill now deals 100% damage (down from 120%)

This unit now has 0% Shield Penetration

This unit now has 20% Shield Penetration

This unit now has 20% Shield Penetration.

notes.title: Director’s Blog - Global Event Briefing, Mamma Maglienza
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders

Today I’m excited to introduce you to our second ever Global Event. Your target is Mamma Maglienza, matriarch of the Maglienza mob family. Take her out and as a community unlock level 16 of the Abyssal Mamma bounty permanently.

Quick Summary


Event: 22nd May, 15:00 GMT - 2nd June 09:00 GMT 
Community goal: Destroy Mamma, fill the global bar before time runs out, unlock Abyssal Mamma bounty stage permanently!
Rewards: Mamma exclusive avatar for all contributors, Abyssal avatar for reaching personal milestone and chance at winning a raffle for 100 specialist beacons
Leaderboards: Top 10 alliances and top 100 players earn prize packages (see table)
New Gear: Piercer set (2 set bonus) +7% Ignore Defence
New Daily Missions: Earn energy cells and points towards your personal and global tally daily

Driven by greed, Mamma, the matriarch of the Maglienza mob family, sent her goons into the Abyss. When none returned, she descended in search of the motherlode alongside Capo, the only henchman she hadn't made cry. There, an encounter with an anomaly exposed her to the Abyssal Virus. Now, as madness consumes her, you must put aside your differences and unite. As a Community, end her suffering to unlock the Abyssal Mamma stage.


Daily Missions, Rewards and Leaderboards

There will be 2 progression tracks active at once:


Community: Defeat Mamma Maglienza Bounty. Each kill earns points for the global bar and your personal tally, the higher the bounty, the more points.

Compete against foes (or friends) and earn your spot at the top of the player and alliance leaderboards. Checkout prizes details below.


Once the event reaches 100%, the leaderboard will close, so use the opportunity to make your mark on the Frontier. Everyone who participates individually and finishes the individual progress event will also enter a raffle for 100 specialist beacons. The top 100 players will get 2 raffle entries.

notes.title: Directors Blog: A song of corrosion and shields
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders,

Today, I want to inform everyone about Anemone and Frontline getting some sorely needed buffs and upcoming combat mechanics changes to provide context and clarity. The first part of the devblog is a shorter version, then we head into the details and for eager theorycrafters like me, scroll even further for the numbers.

Summary

What is changing?
Releasing the next patch on May 12th.


Anemone

 Lower charge cost, stronger self‑repair, tougher against foes suffering Damage over Time.
 New ability to grab Taunt when the target is already bleeding from three or more DoT effects.
 We intend this to make Anemone a sturdier DoT specialist that synergizes better to tank within Gelecek.


Frontline

 Damage now scales with its own shield, and every hit stacks even more shielding.
 Starts combat with a chunky shield, gains Shield Penetration on every attack, and gets a beefy defence boost while the shield holds.
 We intend for Frontline to live up to his actual name, while still satisfyingly packing a punch.


The same patch will also tweak 2 core combat mechanics, Shield Bypass (to be replaced with Shield Penetration) and Ignore Defense (This will become a passive ability). Again, more details and specifics below.

If this where we say goodbye, I’m Ruxster, the Game Director at Solid Clouds, thanks for stopping by. For the rest of you, read further for a more detailed overview of things.

The Details

Why are we doing it?
Both units have fallen behind the meta curve. Rather than dial everyone else down, we are lifting these two up so that corrosive playstyles and shield‑centric tactics feel powerful again. We also acknowledge that these units are current battle pass and upcoming recruitment rush units. Ideally we would not be touching these units around this period. However in order to support the bigger picture evolution of combat, this became a necessity. Hence I am here today, to provide you with as much information as possible so that you can make informed decisions.

One of our core goals is to ensure you can play the way you want to play, and feel powerful and rewarded for doing so. But over time, we’ve seen certain strategies fall behind as others, notably direct damage as a byproduct of power creep, continue to outpace them. This growing imbalance limits the diversity of effective strategies, and that's something we intend to address. Expect more love for under‑represented strategies in future updates.

Our focus is dominantly on lifting underused strategies up, not bringing others down. We want to enhance the tools of playstyles that have fallen behind. I want to reassure you that we are being especially mindful to minimize any disruptions to your current farming teams.

In addition to this, factions across the Starborne universe should feel distinct in theme, mechanics, and playstyle. This is something we believe we can do better, so we're taking steps to bring that back.

What is next?


 Additional unit reworks are in the pipeline.
 We are working on changes to how Increasing and Decreasing critical damage operates. However in order to not disrupt your teams for upcoming global events (More info Friday), these shall be delayed until early June.
 Building upon these mechanical changes, you can then expect to see exciting new faction specific characteristics be introduced alongside our next major content update, Voidbringers. More info on that next week.
 This is the first step toward a stronger foundation for ships, strategies and factions alike that supports deeper, more varied content, new encounter types, and challenging new game modes in the near future.


And for the theory crafters, numbers as promised

Upcoming Unit Reworks:
We believe every unit should have a place within the game. Whether it be in vault runs, endgame pvp, or pushing bounty times to the limit. Anemone and Frontline are two units we believe to have fallen behind the curve, either as a limitation of their intended strategy or through being outscaled. So we are addressing them immediately. There are several other units on our radar that in the near future will also see some additional reworking.

Both unit reworks will be live next patch, currently scheduled for the 12th of May.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/688803252627570741/1369717887698469090/Gelecek_11_Character.png?ex=681ce0b0&is=681b8f30&hm=d557a2a7b0f864c8a59594916b88ba1e3ab2a7917a64ef00be493193db4f5a5e&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=856&height=856

Anemone

Current Ability Set

Active: This unit Deals 165% Damage, inflicts Out. Dot Damage Down II and Corrosion I, both for 2 turns.
Charged: (4 charges) This Unit Deals 215% Damage and, if the enemy has a debuff, applies Provoke for 3 turns and inflicts Corrosion III on them for 2 turns.
Passive: This unit receives 15% less Damage from debuffed enemies. When an enemy takes Damage from a Damage over Time effect, repair 10% of the damage dealt.

Reworked Ability Set

Active: This unit Deals 140% Damage, inflicts Out. Damage Down II and Corrosion I, for 2 turns.
Charged: (3 charges) This Unit Deals 200% Damage and inflicts Corrosion III for 2 turns. If the primary target has 3 or more Damage over Time effects, Gain Taunt for 1 turn.
Passive: This unit receives 25% less Direct Damage from enemies debuffed with Damage over Time effects. When an enemy takes Damage from a Damage over Time effect, repair 5% of this units Max HP.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/688803252627570741/1369717886570205316/Atlas_12_Character.png?ex=681ce0b0&is=681b8f30&hm=7bfcf8c72641d6aba148603fbc81262371a35cf4bd06de22ecbf7003c68d649c&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=856&height=856

FrontLine

Current Ability Set

Active: This unit deals 190% Damage bypassing enemy shield and gains a shield equal to 10% of the Damage Dealt.
Charged: (1 charge) This Unit deals 230% Damage bypassing enemy shields and gains a shield equal to 15% of the Damage Dealt.
Passive: This unit gains Attack Up III for 2 turns after damaging an enemy with an affinity advantage bonus. When an enemy uses their charge skill, deal 80% Damage bypassing enemy shields once per round.

Reworked Ability Set

Active: This unit deals 80% Damage with additional damage equal to 60% of its current shield. This unit gains a shield equal to 30% of the Damage Dealt.
Charged: (4 charges) This Unit deals 160% Damage with additional damage equal to 120% of its current shield. This unit gains a shield equal to 40% of the Damage Dealt.
Passive: This unit’s attacks have 20% Shield Penetration.
This unit starts combat with a shield equal to 25% of its Max HP.
While shielded, this unit has its defense increased by 2500. When an enemy uses their charged skill, this unit deals 80% damage and gains a shield equal to 30% of the damage dealt. This can occur once per round.
Base Stats
HP: 11535 → 21042
DEF: 2924 → 3282
Crit Rate: 16% → 12%
Crit Power: 98% → 90%


As well as reworking several units, we are also modifying several combat mechanics.

Changes to Shield Bypass

The following changes will be implemented for FrontLine and all Non-obtainable NPC units' next patch, currently scheduled for the 12th of May. All other shield penetration changes for obtainable units shall be implemented in the following week, currently scheduled for 19th of May.


 Bypass Shield will be removed in its current implementation. It shall instead be rebranded as ‘Shield Penetration’.
 Shield penetration operates as a percentage based shield bypass. For example, a unit with 20% Shield Penetration that directly damages a unit with a shield, will deal 20% of its damage to the unit's HP, and 80% of its damage to the unit's Shield.
 All obtainable units that currently have bypass shields will see balance adjustments to compensate for this change, particularly in areas where shield bypass currently shines such as in the Eelun Naphula bounty.
 There will also be additional units that did not have bypass shields previously, that will now obtain varying percentages of shield penetration innately.
 Any unit with shield penetration will have it tied to their passive instead of abilities directly. This means that units with a reactive damage passive will also operate using the same shield penetration as the rest of their abilities.
 A complete list of units impacted by this change is as follows:

 Liberator
 Medved
 Laska
 Iridium
 Opal
 Xcellence
 Frontline
 Crucialis
 Apex
 Luxx
 Malvex
 LeSabre
 Curator
 Sustainer
 Vindicator
 Guardian
 Provider


Changes to Ignore Defense:
The following changes will be implemented for next patch, currently scheduled for the 12th of May.


 All units that currently have Ignore Defense on their active or charge shall have it removed from their active and charge abilities.
 In its place, Ignore Defense shall now appear on a unit's passive directly.
 This means a unit with Ignore Defense innately as part of its skillset shall have this benefit applied globally (i.e, Judge will now ignore defense as part of his passive).
 Currently the only unit impacted by this is Judge. But this change adds clarity and consistency to our unit descriptors moving forward.


See you on Friday for some exciting information on the next Global Event, and then again next week to talk all things Voidbringers!

Ruxster
Player turned Game Director - Solid Clouds

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Now in German!
notes.content:
Our latest patch introduced our first step in our localization efforts, our German (beta) version.

Get your translation software or your German great-grand-uncle ready if you want to read the rest, because it's all going to be in Deutsch.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/688803252627570741/1369286023309299832/German.png?ex=681b4e7c&is=6819fcfc&hm=f0ecfd436f239dac0ffceaf61ddbb6e86bd6522c283bf218cc09996ab013bbc6&=&format=webp&quality=lossless

Guten Tag, Kommandeure!

Ab sofort können sie Starborne: Frontiers auch auf Deutsch genießen.
Einfach beim Start des Spiels, oder wenn schon online, in das Einstellungsmenü navigieren und im "Game"-Untermenü die Sprache umstellen.

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/688803252627570741/1368928756248612914/image.png?ex=681aaa80&is=68195900&hm=4fc18baee602da8f16c7394865e4a8e9538492c4970cdfcf847a0b17750a74ec&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1872&height=486

Wie Sie hier sehen können, handelt es sich bei der deutschen Übersetzung, momentan noch, um eine Beta-Version.
Das bedeutet, dass wir uns bewusst sind, dass einige Änderungen und Korrekturen noch nötig sein können.
Wenn Sie einen Fehler entdecken, sei es Rechtschreibung, Grammatik, Satzbau, Logik, oder einfach eine Platzierung, dann würden wir uns freuen, wenn Sie uns das bitte melden.
Dies können sie einfach mit einem offiziellen Support Ticket oder live im Discord Chat im Supportkanal tun.
Ihre Hilfe sowie ihr Feedback sind wie immer willkommen.

Nun eröffnen wir damit ein neues Kapitel in der Geschichte von Starborne: Frontiers, und unsere deutschen Kommandeure sind hier die Vorreiter.
Bestreitet viele Schlachten, rekrutiert neue Einheiten und rüstet für zukünftige Herausforderungen auf!

Kommandeure, wir wünschen Ihnen viel Glück und Spaß!

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.17
notes.content:
Features

The game can now be set to German (Beta Version).
The Squad leader selection now hides the exit combat button.
The Social slide-out now hides the exit combat button.
We have updated the look of the Special Offers tab to accommodate localization text.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.16
notes.content:
Features

You can now join our mailing lists.
The next time a user with an account with a registered email address logs on, they will receive a popup asking permission to be added to this mailing list.
Steam friends!
See which Steam friends play Frontiers and easily add them as friends in-game.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.15
notes.content:
Balance

Demolisher now triggers her passive skill when detonating bombs with her Charged skill.
Arena end-of-season rewards have been adjusted.


UI, Visual & Audio Changes

We have improved the display of the keys in the starmap selection screen.
The text on the anniversary offers has been adjusted.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue that caused Bomb detonating skills to deal more damage than intended.
Fixed an issue causing daily License inbox items to not appear until after a restart.
Fixed an issue that could cause challenge claims to stop working during play.
Fixed an issue with the multicurrency counter not counting keys correctly.
Fixed an issue with unit management freezing when opening quick rank through a unit and then sacrificing that unit in quick rank.
Fixed an issue causing the workshop to not display correctly when tapping on bio notifications in quick rank and then coming back to the workshop.
Fixed a bug that caused two tabs to be displayed at once in the mission panel.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.14
notes.content:
1 Year Anniversary
During the month of April 2025, we celebrate the one-year anniversary of Starborne: Frontiers and we have a bunch of exciting things in store for you!

A 7-Day login reward chain
The return of the Arcade, now with leaderboards
Bunny Butcher, Easter event Bounty boss
A unique Willy Gamish avatar for one-year-old accounts (this will trigger dynamically) 
and more
Visit the Frontier this month and celebrate with us to find out more!

Features

Keys are now displayed on the Starmap tablet when main the mission track is completed.
The Abyss Fragment story is now displayed in order, regardless of the order in which the fragment fights have been visited and defeated.
Fusion tabs are no longer hidden when the legendary unit is fused. Instead, the fuse button for the legendary unit will now simply be disabled, allowing for other units to continue to be fused.
We have made the above-mentioned fusion change based on feedback received from our community, but we want to clarify that this is only a temporary solution.
A complete overhaul of the Fusion panel in the future is still planned.
We apologize for the inconvenience the Fusion panel situation has caused.


Balance

Malvex can now be recruited from beacons.
Malvex had the Refit 5 changed from +40 Hacking to now be +10% Defense.
Chakara, a new Terran Attacker joins the fray and can now be previewed in the Index.
Keep your eyes open for an upcoming recruitment event for this unit!


UI, Visual & Audio Changes

The camera behavior in the Abyss Starmap screen has been adjusted.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue that caused units in the Arena to sometimes deal 0 damage.
Fixed an issue with combat hanging in the electric Anomaly. This fix should affect other combat scenarios as well.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.13
notes.content:
Balance


Lionheart's refitted passive was changed to now exclude redirecting damage from attacks that can target the entire battlefield.
Epic Defenders had their Refit 6 changed to 10% HP and 10% DEF, instead of 10% ATT and 10% DEF.
Malvex joins the fray and will be available in the next Recruitment Rush event.


Bug Fixes


Normal Abyss keys removed from the multicurrency counter.
Fixed an issue with the missing social widget during combat.
Fixed an issue with overlapping new message prompts on the social button in the alliance panel.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.12
notes.content:
Features


Abyss
Abyss levels are now split up into affinities.
A storyline has been added to the normal Abyss.
A star reward track has been added for each affinity in the story Abyss.
Hard Abyss is now unlocked after beating the last harvester in the story Abyss

A "show dispatched" filter has been added to the hangar.
Error handling in combat has been improved aiming to reduce the number of crashes and freezes.


Balance


Isha's passive was changed to now give Offensive Affinity Override when by himself and Defensive Affinity Override when Nayra is on the same team.
Nayra's passive was changed to now give Defensive Affinity Override when by herself and Offensive Affinity Override when Isha is on the same team.
Her active skill was also changed to now deal 170% damage, up from 130%, and inflict Defense Down II instead of Security Down II.
Additionally, her refitted passive skill was changed to now inflict Out. Repair Down II instead of Speed Up II.
Tianchao Faction Operation boss encounter Kratonos level 2 and 3 had their stat adjusted to make them a bit easier to defeat.


UI, Visual & Audio Changes


The Abyss UI has been updated.
Improved lighting and composition in tutorial combat scene.
Added 3 new Marauder campaign combat scenes and reworked older scenes to bring them up to date with new lighting and particle fx.
Reworked starter units attack animations for better visuals and also added new charged variants.
Reworked the ability fx of units that are encountered early such as Shepard’s gas missile attack and Shelter’s repair animation.
Reworked Marauder campaign stage selection scene, adding new particles, improving composition & implementing real-time lighting.
Improved flow during early campaign with better stage node auto selection and camera panning.
Improved lighting in Starmap.
Reworked Starmap gamemode screen selection.
Starmap campaign progress wheel UI now only fills in segments once a chapter is complete (rather than unlocked).


Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue with the Fenri Khaliriz Bounty level 16 Torpedoes, that caused them to sometimes deal more damage than intended.
Fixed an issue with Chrono Reaver ultimate implant that caused it to trigger more than every other turn.
Fixed an issue which caused Isha's ship to block UI elements in the unit management panel.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.11
notes.content:
Balance


Chimei can now be recruited using beacons.


Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue with Lionheart's refit.
Fixed an issue that caused future seasons to show up in the arena leaderboard.
Fixed an issue that caused character portraits to be hidden behind the hangar menu, along with other UI alignment improvements for mobile devices.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.10
notes.content:
Features


Incursions are now available on all difficulties, and beating an encounter in a given difficulty will end the incursions in all other difficulties as well.
The round limit of regular combat has been increased to 200 rounds.
The round limit of Vault combat has been increased to 300 rounds.
Clicking on Avatars in the Arena will now open the info panel for that user.


Balance


Isha will no longer Purge as part of his basic and charged skills.
Additionally, Isha's base defense was lowered, from 4404 down to 4047, to match the other Terran legendary defenders.
His speed has been increased by 10, from 69 to 79 unrefitted, to compensate.

Frontline's Charged skill damage was increased to 230%, up from 210%, no longer removes a charge from the enemy hit, and will now instead give Frontline a shield based on 15% of the damage done, similarly to his Basic attack skill.
The Passive refit has also been changed to now deal damage to an enemy when they use a charged skill, limited to once per round, instead of removing a charge from the enemy with the most charges.

Chimei, an upcoming legendary Tianchao Antimatter Supporter can now be previewed in the Index.


Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue with obtaining 3 stars in combat when finishing with 1 more round available for 3-starring.
Fixed an issue with the top ranks in the Arena leaderboard.
Fixed an issue with the arena season dropdown menu not being scrollable.
Fixed an issue causing the 30-round limit to Arena combat not applying.
Fixed an issue with Exp bits from Incursions not being affected by Exp boosters.
The search in the friend request menu works now.
(searches based on player name, alliance name, and exact match for alliance tag)

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Imperium: Duel - Patch 2.9
notes.content:
Features

New Social Feature
A Friends list has been added to the social tab.
In this new tab players can now add friends to their friends list and send them private messages.
This Social tab can be opened during combat and will remain open during multibattles!

Players can now refer each other using referral codes.
Accounts up to 7 days old can enter another player's referral code.
New referral challenges have been introduced for both the referring and the referred player.

A Duel section has been added to the social tab.

Duels!!!
Players can now duel their friends.
Set up a team and send them as a duel to a friend, they can then respond with their own team.

Duel replays can be shared to the global chat or alliance chat and other players can watch a replay of the duel.
Using duels and replays, players are now able to run Community Tournaments!
Reach out to the community manager for some support if needed.


Arena UI updates
The Arena Attack panel has been updated to show the season number and provide more clarity on the seasonal skills.
Players can now see the opponent they are fighting while the arena battle is ongoing.
The Arena Multibattle popup will show a recap of completed battles.
The Arena outcome panel will now show a recap of completed battles.
Players can now see more information about past arena fights.
Leaderboards for previous Arena seasons will be available.
Players are now able to watch the replay of arena fights (including defense fights).
Arena battle replays can also be shared to the global chat or alliance chat.

End-of-season arena rewards have been updated.

Incursions
Incursions are campaign battles showing up on Hard difficulty and onwards, on a schedule with Incursions occurring every 2 hours and staying active for 1 hour. 
Incursions will spawn on the highest difficulty unlocked by the player only.

Players can now watch replays of Alliance Boss battles.


Balance

The Repair Over Time buff effect duration can be extended again.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.8
notes.content:
Features


Alliance boss fights can now be quit without using keys.
This will forfeit all damage done during that combat.
Exiting combat will now instantly pause combat.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.7
notes.content:
Features


Disconnecting from the server no longer results in a defeat in combat. 
   A new "Do you want to resume?" dialog is now shown if the client was disconnected during combat.
The time between Multi-battles has been decreased to 3 seconds down from 5 seconds.
Thresh can now be recruited using beacons.


UI, Visual & Audio Changes


Thresh has an animated portrait now.


Bugfixes


Fixed an issue that could cause the Turnorder preview in the pre-combat view to be wrong. 
   It should now be displayed correctly even when speed altering buffs or debuffs occur at the very beginning of combat.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.6
notes.content:
Features


Fusions for legendary units now have a limit of one fusion per unit. 
This change is not retroactive.
Thresh the upcoming legendary Binderburg Antimatter Attacker can now be previewed in the index.


Balance


Sansi's Passive Skill was changed to now trigger off of being hit rather than damaged, but instead inflicts Repair Down III, instead of Block Repair. This will trigger even when she blocks an attack while the Block Attacks buff is active. Additionally, her refit was changed to now trigger off of enemies being directly repaired, regardless of the type of skill the repair came from, but can only activate up to 3 times per round.
Purifier's Charged Skill was changed to now additionally Cleanse 1 debuff.
Tygr's Charged Skill cooldown was lowered to 3 charges, down from 4. Additionally, it now first applies the Stasis and deals damage after. Her Passive Skill was also buffed to now grant her a 30% damage increase, up from 20%.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.5
notes.content:
Features


The Alliance Feed now displays automated messages when role changes happen.
Added a settings option to disable screen shake.
Added a V-Sync option in the graphics settings for desktop, the option does not show for mobile. This system should work seamlessly with the auto-adjust performance feature.
A settings option was added to disable reward and challenge notifications.
Added a settings option to change the duration of side notifications.


UI, Visual & Audio Changes


Hayyan has a new ship model.
Abyss borders are now circular.
The chapter name splash was removed from chapter transitions once in Hard+ difficulty in the Campaign.
The app icon should now be circular for Android.
Reworked Marauder ability VFX, improving projectile and splash effects.
Added new splash and hit origin FX systems to improve the clarity of the pattern target and to reduce the need for spawning additional projectiles for each splash target.
Optimized VFX system by adding a developer option to limit ship mesh VFX instances to 1 per volley of hits from an ability. Previously meshes were spawned for each hit, leading to potentially very high mesh counts, and therefore high poly counts.
Refactored projectile hit and collision code.


Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue causing Stealth FX to apply to the wrong (extra) target.
Fixed an issue causing Challenge Goto -> Bounty to break if the user was previously in the Abyss.
Fixed an issue causing hex placement UI to fade between states upon retrying combat.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.4
notes.content:
Features


Tithonus Skill descriptions adjusted for more clarity.
  Tithonus can now be recruited using beacons.
Unit requirements in Dispatch have been adjusted, and now there need to be at least 2 viable units in the unit index that match OR at least one of the units has to be owned by the player.
The suggested unit's filter in Dispatch has received a style update.
The feature unlock for Multibattles is now displayed on the relevant campaign node.
The ability to use multiple energy packs at once has been added.
The currently active Faction Operation is now displayed on the game mode selection button.
The Engineering UI has been updated and moved to the Hangar panel.
Platinum offers now show the amount of materials included even when sold out.


UI, Visual & Audio Changes


Tithonus and Asphodel (and his kitty) now have animated portraits.
The equipment set icon resolution has been increased for better quality.
Offer dialog UIs have received some updates.


Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue with the multibattle dialog resetting the multibattle amount after accessing the inventory.
Fixed an issue with Abyss multibattles not allowing you to use all of the keys you own, just up to the natural cap. The keys used can now exceed this natural cap for players that have acquired keys that exceed the maximum.
Fixed an issue with missing usernames in the start screen.
Fixed an issue causing some players to get stuck on the bounty tutorial and keep getting forced back into playing the Fenri bounty.
Fixed an issue with the Abyss depths being displayed incorrectly in the depth selection.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.3
notes.content:
Features


Commander's path challenges have been updated to better match player progress.
Main mission challenges have been updated.
Added the ability to reroll dispatch missions using platinum. 
The first reroll of the day will be free and each subsequent reroll (of the day) will have an increasing price, up to 100 platinum.
The Multibattle button now shows up in a locked or inactive state with a dialog describing how to unlock multibattles upon clicking the button.
Candy Canes (Stan the Sleigher boss keys) can now be bought in the Platinum Market.
3 keys can be bought this way every day, and they are available as long as the boss event lasts.
New daily login rewards added. 
Progress for the current rewards will remain and will be continued but completion of the new rewards will be done first.


https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1177605085354803230/1318940475583107123/395568942-ca2a8064-fcb2-4861-8af8-296ffaa154d7.png?ex=6764268a&is=6762d50a&hm=1c58c08dc4bc05cd692a1d55859054bbe9c2eaad90b87a15f0a692137d9c4055&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1242&height=702

Balance


Wusheng's Charged Skill no longer applies Stasis and their Passive Skill incoming damage reduction was lowered to 25% (down from 50%).
Faction ops loot has been adjusted to now also drop Quantum Fibers instead of only dropping set cores. 
The Vault key in the reward track has also been replaced by 300 Implant Tokens.


UI, Visual & Audio Changes


Added letter spacing to currency/key counters.
Moved Abyss depth level selection FOB away from UI.
Blended abyss depth overview lights with depth affinity color.
Added color alternator system for weapon fx for better variety.
Added tainted Yazid combat ship variant for end of campaign.


Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue that could cause timed offers and challenges to be completed when they were not.
Fixed an issue with legendary lvl 3 Squad Leader skills in arena. They should now work in arena properly.
Fixed an issue with chemical anomaly attacks looking electrical.
Fixed an issue with electric anomaly attacks looking chemical.
Fixed an issue with some anomalies asset names being swapped.
Fixed an issue with max particles for rate over time count being too low.
Fixed an issue causing the abyss depth overview FOB light being set to max on entry.
Fixed an issue with Starmap anomaly node smoke particles clipping.

Stan the Sleigher Awaits on the Frontier!

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 2.1
notes.content:
Features


New filters have been added to the Hangar!
Players will now be able to filter instead of sort in the hangar.
The filter is very similar to the filters used in the pre-combat unit selection stages.
We have also added the ability to now filter by faction.
Combat power values and sorting have been added to the Hangar as well.
As a result of these changes, we have removed the affinity, role, and faction sorting.

Players now have the ability to hide the dispatched units in the unit selection for combat.
This is saved between sessions.

Dispatch: The timers for new missions now reset at midnight GMT, our usual daily reset time.
Multibattles are now available for hard Abyss boss fights.
We have introduced a new design for the single-unit reveal screen.
Players will be able to preview a unit's skills right then and there.

A "get more" popup, which leads to the market, now appears when players don't have enough XP bits to upgrade a unit.
The Special Offer tab arrows now change between offers, not pages.
Unseen Special Offers and unclaimed Progression Offer rewards now have notification icons.


## UI, Visual & Audio Changes


Rare units in a ten pull now have a slight glow in order to help distinguish them better from other rarities.
Locked feature dialog now shows the player level required to unlock said content.
Cobalt now has an animated portrait!


## Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue with the refit panel being slow/crashing when too many units or refit kits were available for use.
Fixed an issue that could cause the crafting button to deactivate when switching between recipes with the same tech element.
Fixed an issue that could cause asset download to get stuck at 99.9%
*We also improved the display of current asset download progress in the loading screen.*

Fixed an issue that could cause the game to unmute after connecting to Bluetooth.
Fixed an issue that was causing points claimed at the end of a dispatch reward track to be lost.
Fixed an issue with the Abyss depth selection causing a severe visual bug.

notes.content:
Bugfixes:

 Multibattle auto purchase energy with plat now works again

notes.title: Update: 2.0.25504
notes.content:
Bugfixes:

 Faction ops has been opened

 Re-added Neuronets (Tier 3 Skill items) into the Credit Market

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Imperium
notes.content:
Patch 2.0 - Imperium Expansion

Features


New Game mode: Faction Ops
Fight in faction-specific encounters, where you are limited to only using units of a given faction, to earn great new rewards. Among them are brand-new crafting materials, Squad Leaders, and a brand-new legendary unit called Wusheng! 

[*]Introducing Squad Leaders!
Earn Faction leaders by defeating boss encounters in Faction Ops. Faction leaders will increase the capabilities of your units matching the leader's faction in the encounter where you choose them as the leader. Faction Leaders exist in three rarities: rare, epic, and legendary with stronger bonuses for higher-level Faction Leaders.

New Game mode: Dispatch
Send out units on missions of varying lengths to be awarded great awards, among them all new crafting materials. Dispatch will also award a new unit fragment for a brand new legendary unit called Lev!

Introducing Crafting!
Players can start their crafting journey in the Workshop panel. By using the material earned in faction ops and dispatch, among others, players will be able to craft high-tier equipment from 4 brand-new and powerful sets!

New Unit: Wusheng
A brand new legendary Tianchao antimatter attacker who can hit incredibly hard. 
Find out more about Wusheng in the Index.

New Unit: Lev
A brand new legendary XAOC Thermal Attacker who will deal more damage per debuff on the target and can even extend the duration of existing debuffs.
Find out more about Lev in the Index.

Some changes have been made to the Platinum and Credit Market.
The Credit Market now offers one legendary Mainframe per month, and the Specialist Beacon is now sold once a week, instead of once a month.
The Platinum Market now offers 1-hour Credit Boosters and 30-minute EXP Boosters for sale. 

The Index unit view has been updated and now includes the ship model of the unit being viewed. 
The unit view in the Index has also received a general face-lift.


Balance


The Security of the Alliance Raid: The Vault has been reduced slightly.


UI, Visual & Audio Changes


Paracelsus and Incinerator now have animated portraits.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 1.18
notes.content:
Features

We have severely reduced the amount of popups shown when entering the game.
Factions added a sorting option for the Unit hangar.
A home button has been added to most panels.
Skill patterns are now shown for all units, common and uncommon included.
We have also fixed a few minor issues with skill pattern displays.


Balance

Sansi's refitted Passive Skill has been adjusted to now repair only after an enemy is repaired by an active skill, but it now scales with each repaired target, up from a flat value per repair action.
We have adjusted the wording on Pallas' Passive Skill to make it clearer that she will be the recipient of the mentioned buffs.

notes.title: Starborne: Frontiers - Patch 1.17
notes.content:
Features

A new unit has arrived on the Frontier!
Pallas, an epic Everliving attacker who can repair team members while attacking, gain leech, and even steal enemy buffs!
You can find information in her Index entry.
Bayah can now finally be recruited from beacons.


Balance

Zeolite has received an improvement to his targeting pattern for the Charged Skill, allowing him to hit 3 additional targets at the back of his pattern.
You can find a preview of his new pattern in his Index entry.


UI, Visual & Audio Changes

Updates have been made to the homebase UI moving some buttons around.
The Workshop can now be entered through a new button directly from the Homebase view.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue that could keep players from replying to chat messages.
Fixed an unwanted interaction between Detonation skills and the Intrusion implant.

notes.title: Dev Blog - Our October Roadmap
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

Just when you thought September couldn't get any better, we’re back with another dev blog, packed with exciting updates. We’re so excited to share what’s coming in October, so let’s jump right in!


Spooky Season

Faction Ops

In the new Faction Ops game mode, you’ll embark on daring missions against rival factions, using ships from a specific faction. Along the way, you’ll face off against tough bosses, with the chance to earn new Squad Leaders (more details on them soon).

As you complete these missions, you’ll collect crafting components for our brand-new crafting system. Plus, hitting key milestones will unlock some stellar rewards, including a legendary unit.


Crafting

Introducing the crafting system, where you'll discover unique equipment sets: Abyss and Dispatch. To craft these sets, you'll need to gather resources scattered across various game modes. The resources you choose will determine different outcomes, including the type of equipment you're crafting—be it weapons, hulls, or other gear.

Want to tilt the odds in your favor? Use different types of boosters to influence rank, rarity, or boost sub-stats!


Dispatch

Dispatch is a new game mode where you send your units on real-time missions. Success depends on your units' combat power. During these missions, you can collect rewards like unique unit fragments and crafting resources for specific sets.

Each mission is themed around an affinity, faction, or role. If your units match the theme, they'll receive a combat power boost.

The mode features a weekly reward track: the more missions you complete, the better the loot. Plus, meeting certain campaign star requirements will allow you to perform multiple dispatches at once. Multitasking has never been this rewarding!
